sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.15842 of 2017
Order:

Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Panchayat Raj and Rural Development for the respondent Nos.1 and 2, learned Standing Counsel for the respondent No.3, none appeared on behalf of the respondent Nos.4 to 10 and perused the entire material on record.

2. As per the counter submitted by the respondent No.3, the official respondents are not interfering with the possession of the petitioners' properties situated at Banda Ravirala Village, Abdhullapur Mandal, Ranga Reddy District and they are not taking any steps to lay the road in the properties of the petitioners.
3.
In view of the same, the writ petition is disposed of directing the official respondents not to interfere with the possession of the petitioners' properties without following due process of law.

If the respondents wants ::2::
to acquire the land of the petitioners, they have to follow the procedure as contemplated under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013

sentences.text: However, there shall be no order as to costs.
4. Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Writ Petition shall stand closed.
